title: Distinct partial products in prime dihedral groups
summary: Let $D_{2p}$ be the dihedral group of order $2p$, where $p$ is prime. For every fixed $0<\alpha<1$, we prove that every subset $A\subseteq D_{2p}\setminus\{e\}$ with $C_\alpha\le |A|\le p^\alpha$ admits an ordering whose nonempty partial products are pairwise distinct. Combined with the known small- and large-set theorems, this covers every subset size for all sufficiently large primes. Pairing reflections reduces the products to partial sums with fixed parity-labelled offsets.
